query: Which author has won more Pulitzer Prizes, Thomas Friedman or Henri Bergson?

retrieved_context: Henri Bergson: Henri-Louis Bergson (] ; 18 October 1859 – 4 January 1941) was a French philosopher, influential especially in the first half of the 20th century and after WWII in continental philosophy.
Thomas Friedman: Thomas Loren Friedman (born July 20, 1953) is an American journalist and author.  He is a three time Pulitzer Prize winner.
